title: Record the flexibility budget of a proposed decipherment
question: How many optional readings, exceptions and selection choices are needed before a proposed procedure matches its examples?
rationale: A visible flexibility budget turns a vague dispute into inspectable assumptions and testable out-of-sample predictions.
distinctness: Operationalizes an audit of a particular complete procedure; it is not a generic request to use AI or try a new language.

prior_work_check.scope: Bounded launch-source catalog and current seed directions inspected; this does not establish world-first novelty.

first_step: Choose one publicly specified procedure and tabulate every discretionary choice on a fixed passage.
limitations: Candidate suggestion only; detailed protocol and execution are future work.
Designated seed: zero competitive allocations; evidence-tier baseline awaits official assessment.
attribution: voynich.win launch curation, AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex; exposed precise model version not recorded
